author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The United States and Denmark are in the final stages of discussions to enhance US military operations in Greenland. This strategic arrangement will not infringe on Greenland's autonomy, affirming its status as a Danish territory. The talks also involve strategies to curb Chinese activity in this vital Arctic locale. A potential agreement might include establishing a US missile defense system, with an official update expected shortly.
title: US reaches deal with Denmark for ‘permanent security control’ over Greenland

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: President Trump has officially enacted a new sanctions law aimed at Russia and Iran, empowering the U.S. to impose penalties on nations purchasing Russian energy supplies. Countries like India and China, significant buyers of Russian crude and gas, have raised concerns about the potential impact on India-US relations and energy security. Both Russia and China have also expressed their discontent towards these sanctions.
title: Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law, allowing up to 100% tariffs on India

title: Dengue vaccine to hit market by first half of 2027

author: ABHINAV GARG, NAOMI CANTON, NEEL KAMAL

title: Rajnath flags HAL delays, calls for realistic project timelines

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: President Donald Trump has enacted a swift exclusion of three major news outlets—CNN, MS NOW, and Politico—from White House premises. He branded their regular reports as 'FAKE NEWS,' marking a bold stance against media he perceives as adversarial. Trump warned that more outlets could follow if they continue to publish misleading narratives about his presidency.
title: Trump bans news outlets CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Bristol City Council spent £9.7 million on a 400-metre floating Harbour Walkway, initially estimated at £2.5 million and designed to connect Temple Meads station to a planned music arena. The arena was later moved to Filton. The walkway now connects the station’s new eastern entrance with the University of Bristol’s £500 million campus.
title: Bristol’s £9.7m Harbour Walkway links Temple Meads to £500m campus

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Terry Bradshaw believes Nick Saban left Alabama because he did not want to keep dealing with NIL, recruiting and roster changes. Saban had raised concerns about college football before retiring in 2024. Since then, he has remained involved in the debate and now supports the Protect College Sports Act, which aims to create national rules for college athletics.
title: Terry Bradshaw reveals why Nick Saban had enough at Alabama

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Basketball legend Wilt Chamberlain's Bel-Air mansion has sold for approximately $9.7 million. This sale concluded years of attempts to sell the property at a much lower price. The 9,395-square-foot home was originally commissioned by Chamberlain in 1971. After extensive renovations, the property was relisted multiple times with significant price cuts. The final sale price was nearly half of its highest asking price.
title: Wilt Chamberlain's $1M Bel-Air estate sells for $9.7M after $19M ask

author: SANJAY KHAJURIA
title: Birthday murder: Man killed for smearing cake on friend’s face; two held

author: SABI HUSSAIN
description: For the karate contingent, reigning Asian champion Alisha Choudhary’s repeated pleas to sports authorities and Indian Olympic Association (IOA) officials for accreditation for her coach, Vikas Panchal, have gone unheard.
title: Asian Games: Karate team leaves without coaches; equestrian riders caught in accred maze

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Poland has joined a significant anti-ballistic missile coalition with Ukraine and other European allies. This new project aims to develop an alternative and more affordable missile defense system. Prime Minister Donald Tusk also announced a substantial new donation package for Ukraine. The announcement occurred during the first Carpathian Summit focused on regional security and cooperation. Both nations emphasized their strong partnership and shared opposition to Russian aggression.
title: Poland joins coalition to strengthen Ukraine’s air defences against Russia

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Freddie Freeman’s wife Chelsea Freeman is drawing attention with a recent social media moment, but her story goes far beyond the Los Angeles Dodgers spotlight. From raising three sons with Freddie Freeman to making MLB All-Star appearances and building her own business, Chelsea Freeman has created an identity of her own. Her latest appearance offers another glimpse into her family life, personal style and growing ventures.
title: Chelsea Freeman: How did Freddie Freeman’s wife build her own identity?

title: ‘No doubts’: Lone holdout juror says Lindsay Clancy deliberately killed her 3 kids

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a remarkable turn of events, a historic Arts and Crafts bungalow from 1910 was spared from demolition by developers. The property underwent a meticulous restoration that lasted several years, ensuring modern systems were integrated while retaining its classic charm. Ultimately, this stunning 3,074-square-foot residence was sold for an impressive $1.47 million, preserving a vital chapter of local history.
title: Preservationist saves Oregon bungalow from demolition; restored home sells for $1.47 million

author: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA
description: A 2006 incident involving Senator George Allen and a racial slur highlights how small remarks can alter election outcomes.  Recent social media posts by Republican Bo French have also drawn significant criticism and condemnation.  These events suggest a growing unease among some Republicans regarding Trump's influence.  Moderate Republicans and even prominent figures are distancing themselves from controversial rhetoric.  Such shifts could impact the upcoming midterm elections and future political landscapes.
title: From Macaca to MAGA: How one needling remark can become a political thorn for Trump

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A UN report documented widespread sexual violence by Russian forces in Ukraine.  These violations included gang rape and genital mutilation against civilians and prisoners.  Ukrainian authorities were responsible for a smaller number of similar human rights abuses.  Most victims of sexual violence in detention were men, according to the UN findings.  The report highlights the ongoing nature of these abhorrent acts amid the conflict.
title: UN report finds widespread sexual violence in Ukraine war, 89% of cases linked to Russia

title: Kyiv comes under missile attack, explosions heard across Ukrainian capital

description: Agarkar was appointed chairman of the men's senior selection committee in July 2023, and his contract is scheduled to end next month.
title: 'Fifteen days is a long time': BCCI plays wait-and-watch on Ajit Agarkar's future

author: AYUSH PANDEY
description: Mamata Banerjee has challenged the Election Commission's decision in the Supreme Court. The poll panel froze the Trinamool Congress name and symbol for upcoming bypolls. Her faction received a new name and symbol for the October 6 elections. The rival faction was allotted a different name and symbol by the ECI. The dispute over the original party identity remains unresolved by the commission.
title: Mamata moves Supreme Court against EC decision to freeze TMC name, symbol

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The currency is now hovering back to its two-month lows. While the RBI is intervening to prevent major volatility, the fact is the rupee is still facing immense pressure, and experts believe the currency is unlikely to appreciate much any time soon.
title: RBI has record forex reserves, but why is rupee still not out of the woods?

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Seventeen new public restrooms are set to debut throughout New York City, enhancing accessibility across all five boroughs. These high-tech facilities will have a strict ten-minute usage limit to accommodate more users. Access can be facilitated through QR codes, text, or a specialized app. Each restroom boasts touchless features, ADA compliance, climate control, and baby-changing facilities. This initiative represents a year-long pilot program focused on public health improvements.
title: NYC's new 10-minute public bathrooms: 'Not a place to scroll'

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Residential prices in eleven emerging Tier-2 Indian cities have grown significantly faster. These smaller markets are now driving India's next phase of real estate expansion. Infrastructure development and rising consumption are supporting this accelerated price growth. Commercial activity is also expanding across these developing urban centers. Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities are projected to contribute substantially to India's real estate sector.
title: Tier-2 cities see housing prices rise nearly twice as fast as top 8 markets: Report

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: After a devastating construction site accident left Avinash Rathod without both hands, his wife's steadfast support became his beacon of hope. Through tireless recovery efforts, he not only regained his ability to walk but also found a new opportunity as a driver. Rathod's active involvement in Ganpati celebrations showcases his triumphant spirit, demonstrating that overcoming adversity can lead to rediscovering one's purpose.
title: Driver who lost hands in accident rebuilds life for family

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Mike Love, the iconic singer of the Beach Boys, has put his stunning Lake Tahoe estate on the market for an impressive forty-three million dollars. This beautiful property has been cherished by his family for over 40 years. Originally purchased as undeveloped land, this expansive estate now showcases breathtaking lake and mountain views, providing a serene retreat.
title: Beach Boys co-founder Mike Love lists his Lake Tahoe estate for $43 million

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Arthur Blank is enhancing his business footprint in Montana with the introduction of Auster at Dome Mountain, a stunning riverfront lodge situated by the Yellowstone River. After acquiring this historic site in December 2021, he meticulously redeveloped it to include accessible dining and retail spaces for the public, furthering his longstanding dedication to conservation within the picturesque Paradise Valley.
title: Arthur Blank’s Montana ranches now span 33,000+ acres after 25 years

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India's metro network has expanded significantly, now spanning 26 cities.  The nation is nearing the US in metro network length, trailing only China.  This rapid growth has occurred primarily within the last decade.  Hundreds of kilometers of new metro lines are currently under construction.  Future expansion will focus on integration and passenger demand for sustainability.
title: India's metro boom: From one city to a network set to overtake the US

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The Rs 22,569-crore IPO has become India’s second-largest public issue, behind Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870-crore offering in 2024. It has also moved past LIC’s Rs 21,000-crore IPO of 2022, but remains smaller than Hyundai Motor India’s record issue.
title: NSE IPO subscribed 1.16 times on Day 2 led by non-institutional investors, QIBs

title: BCCI books separate accommodation for men's cricket team at Asian Games

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Sam Altman sought Peter Thiel's guidance after ChatGPT's initial launch. Thiel advised doubling down on the flexible text box model, comparing it to Google's success. This advice countered prevailing Silicon Valley wisdom about needing feeds and network effects. Altman also learned from Thiel and Paul Graham about valuing unpopular investment opportunities. These lessons shaped Altman's investment strategy for hundreds of companies.
title: Sam Altman went to Peter Thiel, who told him the big ‘Google mistake' he is making

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Receiving kindness can be an uncomfortable experience for many, invoking feelings of awkwardness. This unease can originate from various psychological factors and past experiences. Some view kindness as an obligation or believe they must earn affection. Likewise, receiving compliments can conflict with one's self-perception. Cultivating the ability to accept little gestures of care can significantly reduce this discomfort.
title: Why too much kindness can feel uncomfortable, according to psychology

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The birthday candle tradition has transformed over the centuries, originating from ancient Greek rituals to 18th-century German customs. At Kinderfest, candles adorned cakes to symbolize age and good fortune, with extinguished flames tied to making wishes. As migration and popular culture took hold in the 19th century, this heartfelt practice spread worldwide, maintaining its significance as a simple yet cherished ritual of celebrating life's milestones.
title: Why we blow out birthday candles: The surprisingly old tradition

title: Detection dogs made Georgia weasel survey 33 times more effective

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Daniel Tom, 31, started Bay Area Sanitation in California in 2023 with one truck and 100 portable toilets. The business became profitable within its first year and generated $4.3 million in 2025. It now operates nearly 2,000 toilets and 12 trucks, with Tom focusing on long-term rentals, regular cleaning and reinvesting profits to expand the company further.

description: Nestlé India stated its infant nutrition products fully comply with regulations. The company submitted a detailed response to FSSAI regarding promotional claims. FSSAI initiated legal action over alleged non-compliances with infant nutrition product regulations. A separate sample of a Nestlé follow-up formula was found sub-standard. Three adjudication cases have been filed against Nestlé India for these products.

title: 'Dirty game': Cong claims its Nandigram candidate arrested after Mamata extended support

India posted 182 for six after being sent in to bat by Aussie skipper Jack Czosnek, with Chauhan making 54 off 34 balls and Anvay, son of former India captain Rahul Dravid, scoring 38 off 18.
title: Sehwag shines, Dravid goes ballistic as India beat Australia by seven runs

author: KUNAL VARMA
description: Sachin Pilot has successfully brought together key leaders of the Punjab Congress, such as Channi and Warring, as they gear up for the 2027 assembly elections. With Rahul Gandhi positioned as the prominent figure of their campaign, this strategic move is designed to counter formidable opponents like the Aam Aadmi Party. However, Pilot now faces the crucial task of maintaining this unity through to the elections.

description: The Election Commission has designated new names and symbols for both Mamata Banerjee's faction and its competitor. This decision mirrors previous disputes seen in Maharashtra with Shiv Sena and NCP. The commission is now tasked with determining the rightful claim to the original TMC name and symbol, influenced heavily by recent Supreme Court decisions that prioritise organisational support in addition to electoral backing.

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: The Buffalo Bills face uncertainty after DJ Moore's injury during their new stadium opener.  Former cornerback Darius Butler suggests Brandin Cooks could join the team soon.  Cooks is reportedly open to returning to the NFL after visiting another team.  He has a strong resume and knows the Bills' offensive system well.  Moore's absence significantly impacts the Bills' offensive strategy and playmaking abilities.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Lucinda Southworth, married to Google co-founder Larry Page, is a passionate advocate for ocean conservation through her organization, Oceankind. Since 2018, Oceankind has generously contributed over $120 million to improve marine ecosystems and support community health. With a focus on addressing pressing challenges like climate change and pollution, the organization champions innovative solutions and effective policies to protect our oceans worldwide.
title: Google cofounder Larry Page’s wife’s company has donated over $120m in ocean projects

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Florida city has made a zoning change that blocks a resident from constructing his much-anticipated retirement home. After acquiring the lot nearly two decades ago with plans for development, he now faces obstacles due to new city regulations aimed at boosting commercial growth. The legal challenge claims these changes infringe upon his constitutional rights, showcasing the significant effects of zoning laws on property owners' expectations.
title: Florida rezoning blocks man’s retirement home 18 years after he bought lot

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: After nearly five decades, piping plovers triumphantly return to Wisconsin Point, symbolizing a remarkable achievement in conservation. Thanks to a dedicated $4.5 million habitat restoration initiative, 14 acres of essential nesting and feeding grounds have been established from harbor sediment. Protective measures like seasonal closures and predator exclosures have been implemented to ensure the safety of these delicate birds.
title: Wisconsin turned harbour dredge into habitat; rare plovers returned after 49 years

title: 'Congress is Bhasmasur': Rijiju hits back at Rahul Gandhi over 'party breaking' charge

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: The father of a Nithari case victim questions Surendra Koli's death, alleging murder. Koli was found hanging in Haridwar, with police investigating the scene. The victim's father believes Koli was murdered and not a suicide victim. He suggests Koli might have been killed if he knew crucial case information. The Nithari case involved the discovery of skeletal remains in Noida.

author: CHETHAN KUMAR
description: HAL successfully delivered two LCA Tejas twin-seater trainers to the Indian Air Force, along with the first HTT-40 basic trainer, dubbed Ankur. Additionally, four Dhruv Next Generation helicopters were handed over to Pawan Hans Limited. These significant deliveries mark the initiation of a new phase in HAL's contract obligations, showcasing India's ongoing strides in indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities.

description: Abhishek tore into the Afghanistan bowling attack, scoring 108 off just 34 balls with 11 sixes. His innings took India to 221 for 7 after Afghanistan chose to field first.

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Warren Buffett, after a remarkable tenure since 1965, has officially resigned as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway. Although he is stepping down, he will still contribute as a shareholder and board member, providing invaluable insights. His son, Howard G. Buffett, will take over the chairmanship, with Susan L. Decker maintaining her position as lead independent director, showcasing the company's commitment to its long-term succession strategy.
title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited delivered Tejas twin-seater trainers and HTT-40 basic trainers to the Indian Air Force. Dhruv Next Generation helicopters were also handed over to Pawan Hans Limited. These deliveries mark a significant step in India's self-reliance journey for aerospace. The HTT-40 aircraft will support basic pilot training stages. The Tejas twin-seaters will aid in advanced type-conversion training for pilots.
title: Tejas & HTT-40 trainers, Dhruv choppers take flight: HAL's big push to build aerospace power

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Indonesia gets first aircraft carrier, sparks debate over cost & military ambitions

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Pakistan faces a severe security deterioration with over a thousand security personnel fatalities this year.  More than 650 civilians have also died in violent incidents between January and September.  Baluchistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa are principal theatres of ongoing insurgent violence.  Incidents have risen significantly since 2022, following the Taliban's Afghanistan takeover.  The Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan seeks to unite Pashtun areas and establish Sharia rule.
title: Pakistan security crisis deepens: Nearly 1,000 forces killed in 9 months

author: AASHISH VASHISTHA
title: From H-1B to green cards: Why Indian tech workers are facing a double squeeze in the US

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Mamata Banerjee declared the internal dispute a "black day" in India's democratic history. Her camp's Nandigram candidate withdrew nomination after the Election Commission froze the party name. The Election Commission assigned new names and symbols to rival Trinamool Congress factions. Banerjee's faction received "Mamata All India Trinamool Congress" and the "Football Player" symbol. Her camp will now support the Congress party in Nandigram and Assam.
title: ‘Unconstitutional, illegal, undemocratic’: Mamata after EC assigns new symbol and name

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Bill Gates has significantly increased his investment in Republic Services, a major waste management firm. His private investment company, Cascade Investment, recently acquired over three million additional shares. This substantial holding now represents more than thirty-eight percent of the company's outstanding common stock.  Such a large stake could potentially generate substantial annual dividend income for Gates. Republic Services operates across the United States, handling waste collection and recycling services.
title: Bill Gates may earn at least $313.7 million every year from this ‘boring’ business

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Maryland plans to replace the Chesapeake Bay Bridge with two new spans and widen nearby routes. Farmers and conservation groups on the Eastern Shore are seeking a dedicated land preservation fund, saying the project could increase development pressure on farmland. Three counties have backed the proposal, which remains a concept as discussions with state agencies continue.
title: Maryland bridge replacement plan sparks fears over loss of Eastern Shore farmland

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a remarkable fusion of ancient and modern techniques, scientists have burned contemporary scrolls to unravel the secrets of ancient writings. The innovative use of leaded ink was highlighted through X-ray scans, providing insights into fragile scrolls from Herculaneum. By adapting advanced software, researchers achieved layer separation, paving the way for a more secure recovery of vanished historical texts.
title: Scientists burn modern papyrus to help read 2,000-year-old Vesuvius scrolls

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: In a surprising twist, a political party has raised concerns about a news channel's decision to honor Neerja Modi School. This institution has been under intense scrutiny due to the tragic death of a nine-year-old student last year, who reportedly fell from the fourth floor. Following this incident, the CBSE revoked the school's affiliation, citing serious safety violations, and a police chargesheet has been filed to address the matter.
title: CJP questions award to Jaipur school where 9-year-old Amaira died

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The Marathi film 'Gondhal' has been selected to represent India at the 99th Academy Awards. Set against the backdrop of a traditional ritual in rural Maharashtra, this film was chosen from a pool of thirty-three entries by the selection committee. Notably, it is the fourth Marathi film to earn an Oscar nomination, with the ceremony scheduled for March 14, 2027.
title: Marathi film 'Gondhal' selected as India's official entry for the Oscars 2027

author: MANOJ DHAKA
description: In a shocking incident, a six-month-old baby was severely injured by a pet pit bull that escaped from a neighboring house. The aggressive dog lunged at the infant, dragging him by the jaw until quick-thinking bystanders intervened. The child underwent over twenty stitches and was later transferred to PGIMS Rohtak for advanced treatment. Officials are still awaiting a formal complaint concerning this alarming dog attack.
title: 6-month-old boy mauled by pit bull in Sonipat, CCTV captures terrifying attack

author: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI
description: Raja D King will distribute iPhones publicly on September 22 in Chandigarh. Selected recipients from Chandigarh and Mohali will receive iPhone 17 models. Winners must write "Jai Mata Di" daily until they receive their phones. This initiative follows his earlier postponed petrol langar event. The distribution will expand to ten more Punjab cities later.
title: Raja D King’s ‘iPhone Langar’ in Chandigarh: 10 phones and a ‘Jai Mata Di’ rule

author: ANJALI SINGH
description: Swatantra Bhardwaj, the social media influencer, was released from Tihar Jail after a Delhi court granted him three weeks' interim bail related to an alleged assault charge. The court enforced strict rules, particularly preventing him from sharing details of the case online. Bhardwaj's detention earlier this month followed an incendiary interview. The next court date is set for October 6, where the situation will be reassessed.
title: Jantar Mantar attacker Swatantra Bhardwaj released from Tihar on 3-week interim bail

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: At 33, Anu Raghavan has survived Rio heartbreak, financial uncertainty and personal loss. Now, armed with data, belief and one final shot, India's 400m hurdler returns to the Asian Games chasing the moment she was denied eight years ago.

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: In a troubling turn of events, a Chinese Coast Guard ship collided with a boat from the Philippine Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources while it was refueling local fishermen. Although the Philippine vessel sustained structural damage, no injuries were reported. China claims that the Philippine boat ignored warnings and changed its course, further escalating tensions in the already contentious South China Sea.
title: Watch: Chinese coast guard vessel rams civilian Philippine boat in South China Sea

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The National Stock Exchange of India's IPO saw full subscription on its second day. Strong demand from institutional investors drove the significant subscription levels. Qualified Institutional Buyers and non-institutional investors showed robust interest in the offering. The IPO is an entirely an offer for sale, with proceeds going to selling shareholders. NSE shares are expected to debut on the market on September twenty-fourth.
title: NSE’s mega IPO crosses full subscription mark with strong institutional demand

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission ordered Vishal Mega Mart to refund a customer Rs 182 for an expired food product.  The retailer also must pay Rs 10,000 for compensation and litigation costs.  The customer had purchased the expired item on December 1, 2025, and received no response.  Vishal Mega Mart denied deficiency in service and unfair trade practices.  The commission found the retailer guilty of selling an expired product to the complainant.

description: Parthiv Patel is a strong candidate to lead the men's senior selection committee if Ajit Agarkar's tenure is not extended by the BCCI. Key figures have discussed Patel as a potential successor for the job. Agarkar's recent absence from a review meeting had further fueled speculation.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Ishtiaq Ali, an 85-year-old artist, carves Lord Ganesha onto a living tree.  His unusual method and dedication have garnered significant social media attention.  He spent decades working daily wage jobs before finding purpose in his art.  Ali explains the significance of making idol eyes last and the trunk's direction.  This Muslim artist's work showcases his deep understanding of Hindu deities.

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: Austin Tice, a journalist, disappeared in Syria in 2012 while covering the civil war.  New BBC findings suggest his driver betrayed him to the Syrian regime for rewards.  Confidential intelligence files indicate the Syrian government detained Tice after his alleged abduction.  His mother maintains he is alive and being treated well by his captors.  The US government continues its active investigation and offers a reward for his return.

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: In a noteworthy real estate move, Charlie Puth has divested his Montecito estate for a stunning eighteen point five million dollars, significantly higher than his 2017 acquisition cost of four point one seven million dollars. This charming residence holds cherished memories, including his marriage to Brooke Sansone two years ago. This transaction showcases Puth's impressive financial progression, complementing his recent California property sales.

author: ROSHAN GUPTA
description: A honeymoon in Darjeeling turned tragic for a newlywed couple from Chopra.  The wife sustained severe burn injuries during a barbecue incident at a homestay.  Her husband bravely fought the flames engulfing her, as shown in a video.  Relatives allege the homestay authorities delayed crucial medical assistance for the victim.  The woman remains in critical condition while police investigate the incident.

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: India’s first indigenous hydrogen-powered train was launched on July 17, marking a step towards the use of next-generation clean and sustainable transportation technology.

description: A devastating incident took place involving a law student who was fatally stabbed after turning down a marriage proposal. The tragic confrontation erupted upon her realization that her suitor had a prior marriage, prompting a violent response. Despite a valiant struggle lasting over two days, she ultimately succumbed to her injuries. Police have apprehended two brothers believed to be involved in this tragic event.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Born in Cairo, Egypt and raised in Texas, Dina Powell McCormick gave up her Meta board seat last December after Mark Zuckerberg asked her to take an operating job instead. author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Kentucky farmer discovered over 800 Civil War-era gold and silver coins. This extraordinary hoard, valued at more than three million dollars, was found buried. The collection included rare 1863 Double Eagle gold coins, highly prized by collectors. Historical context suggests the coins were hidden during the dangerous Civil War period. Private buyers eventually purchased the entire collection from the anonymous finder.
title: Kentucky farmer's $3M find: 800+ rare coins unearthed in field

description: Javis Sims inherited his childhood home in Boynton Beach in 2009 and says he has spent thousands trying to restore it. With code fines exceeding $700,000, the vacant property was declared unsafe and uninhabitable in 2022. The city says demolition is now required, while Sims continues seeking help to save his house from demolition.
title: Florida man hit with $700K fines as city moves to raze inherited home

author: TNN
description: A father allegedly murdered his five-year-old daughter in Rajkot due to financial difficulties. He then placed her decorated body inside the refrigerator before taking his own life. Preliminary investigations and suicide notes pointed towards severe financial distress from a construction project. The man had also invested personal loan money into the ill-fated construction site. Police are examining the circumstances surrounding the tragic events in the village.
title: Rajkot man kills 5-year-old daughter, stores body in fridge; ends life
